answer: To assess whether a FRIA is necessary, the tool must determine the role of the entity under the AI Act (deployer or provider), the categorization of the AI system as high-risk, and whether there is a valid exception or exemption for its use-case. This involves evaluating whether the AI system is being developed and put on the market and/or deployed, and if it satisfies any high-risk criteria established in the relevant articles of the AI Act.
